summary: postinstall fetches and executes binary from hardcoded bare-IP endpoint with TLS verification disabled
details: The package's postinstall lifecycle script (ensurePlatformBinary) downloads a.tgz archive over HTTPS from a hardcoded bare IP endpoint (218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/...), extracts it with tar, chmods the extracted binary to 0755, and hardlinks it as bin/.onecode so it runs as the package's CLI. The HTTPS request passes rejectUnauthorized: false, disabling TLS certificate validation, and no hash or signature check is performed on the downloaded archive. On every default `npm install` of this version, arbitrary code from a non-publisher network location is fetched and made executable on the installer's machine, and any on-path attacker can substitute the archive contents undetected.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
